import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    # Keep only rows with valid positive quantities
    df = df[df['Quantity'] >= 1].copy()
    # Normalize Region labels (strip whitespace and standardize case)
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].astype('string').str.strip().str.title()
    return df

def answer(df):
    avg_price = df.dropna(subset=['Category']).groupby('Category')['Price'].mean()
    return {str(category): round(float(price), 2) for category, price in avg_price.items()}
